title: ALL ON-SCREEN TEXT GOES INTO THE FEED
why: His order 2026-10-15: "All text shown to the player on screen also goes into the player feed." say() and world labels already fed it. Four texts still bypassed it: the map story lore card (name and text), the last-second cooked grenade shout, ACTIVE RELOAD, and a CLOSE CALL label with no score. They are feed lines now. WEAK SPOT, PICKED UP and NOTORIETY +n stay out on purpose (hit mark, pickup row, own line).
now: The story card, a cooked grenade shout, ACTIVE RELOAD and CLOSE CALL also show in the feed.

edits.replacement:
var _cshout=cookShout(p);
      try{ cookFeed(p); }catch(_cfd){}   // v28.xx (cw-feedall): the shout is in the feed too

edits.anchor: if((/^(WEAK SPOT|ACTIVE RELOAD|PICKED UP|CLOSE CALL|NOTORIETY \+\d+)$/).test(s)||(/ (DESTROYED|ELIMINATED)$/).test(s)||feedPwrOf(s)) return null;
